# Plan

Plan the requested work without modifying the repository.

First apply the repository discovery methodology in [repo-discovery](../repo-discovery/SKILL.md). Challenge the requested approach if repository evidence suggests a simpler or safer path.

The plan must define acceptance criteria, exact likely files/components, verification steps, risks, and what is intentionally out of scope. Finish with the smallest useful first implementation slice.
